ibm.label: IBM Quantum hardware
ibm.detail: pip install qiskit-ibm-runtime and set AMRQ_IBM_TOKEN

target.name: NDM-1 metallo-beta-lactamase
target.resistance_mechanism: Zinc-dependent metallo-enzyme: hydrolyses nearly all beta-lactams including carbapenems. Serine-beta-lactamase inhibitors (clavulanate, avibactam) do NOT inhibit it.
target.clinical_note: WHO critical-priority carbapenemase; spreads on plasmids across Enterobacterales worldwide. No approved NDM inhibitor as of 2026.
target.notes: Zn1 ligands His120/His122/His189; Zn2 ligands Asp124/Cys208/His250. Metal-chelating compounds (ciclopirox, captopril, dipicolinate, aspergillomarasmine A) and thiol inhibitors are reported NDM-1 inhibitors - the quantum model scores metal chelation explicitly for this target.
